cast.name: Rhea Calder
cast.portrait: Early/mid twenties in 1991; short dark-brown hair, olive skin, grey-green eyes, high cheekbones and freckles near the left cheek; plain navy flight suit.
cast.bio: 1991 personnel file. Rhea likes finishing an explanation before someone has finished asking for it. Her new posting brings her among people who notice the difference between understanding and anticipation. She wants to become the pilot they can trust with an uncertain instruction, and fears that admitting uncertainty will make them choose somebody else.

cast.name: Malik Renn
cast.portrait: Early/mid twenties in 1991; warm dark-brown skin, short tight black curls, dark eyes, clean-shaven broad face; plain slate flight suit.
cast.bio: 1991 personnel file. Malik makes a difficult room easier to enter. His humor and willingness to cover another shift have earned him friends who sometimes forget he has a life beyond the station. He likes Rhea enough to compete with her honestly, although he is still learning how to tell her when generosity has begun to hurt.

cast.name: June Carver
cast.portrait: Early thirties in 1991; fair freckled skin, short auburn hair and blue-grey eyes; plain navy maintenance coveralls; no permanent bandage.
cast.bio: 1991 personnel file. June teaches a check by explaining what the next pair of hands needs to know. She is proud of being useful and uncomfortable when usefulness becomes a reason nobody else is allowed to learn. Her friendship with the younger crew will be tested by rest, privacy and the difficult business of letting someone help.

cast.name: Sana Ivers
cast.portrait: Late twenties in 1991; medium-brown skin, black hair in a low bun, brown eyes and thin round glasses; dark shirt and unmarked headset.
cast.bio: 1991 personnel file. Sana can hear when a confident voice has stopped listening. She keeps a weak second receiver beside the main set because a quiet request still comes from somebody. She wants the crew to share that attention without treating every unanswered sound as a promise they can fulfill.
